title: Fix Puzzle 3d Play Boot
description: 3d puzzle play fails at boot with ReferenceError: Tags is not defined in registerSceneSurfaceHosts. Missing lucide-react imports in Puzzle3dPlayHost region; verify useGLTF preload and full boot.
summary: Fixed 3d play boot crash: registerSceneSurfaceHosts used Tags/ClipboardList/ListTree/Settings without lucide imports and useGLTF without sceneHostPort. Consolidated lucide imports at file top to avoid Babel duplicate-declaration in dev. Extended playground UiRenderer for tree/section/field/input/select/toggle/vec3/keyValue declarative nodes so document/kinds/inspector/settings panels render. Wired PlaygroundView detailsTabs from activeApp.rightTabs so inspector and settings tabs appear. Verified dev (canvas + Nakagin document, no Unsupported UiNode); playground renderer vitest 12/12; puzzle 3d play production build succeeds.
